subject: 阳城海会寺小砖塔与明代琉璃大塔
caption: 海会寺 · 小砖塔与琉璃大塔
五代—宋小塔 · 明嘉靖至隆庆大塔
source_note: 同一实际照片可见两塔，从左小右大关系转绘。小塔六角十级，最高一级为斜肩塔顶；大塔八角十三级，最低三层包砌城堡状台体，外露十层，第十层为悬空琉璃楼阁，其上三层。基部被附属建筑与围栏遮挡处只保留朴素轮廓，不臆补复杂入口。朝代按视觉主塔明代，大、小塔年代分别说明，未套唐代寺院创建年。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a heritage architecture fine-line plate for 访古.
Image1 is STYLE MASTER ONLY, the Longmen Buddha contour drawing. Match its delicate slightly organic thin strokes, sparse selected details and large open white areas. Image2 is ACTUAL SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: Haihui Temple's two DIFFERENT pagodas at Daqiao village, Yangcheng, Shanxi. Draw the pair as photographed, the shorter old six-sided brick pagoda on the LEFT and much taller eight-sided Ming glazed pagoda on the RIGHT. Their identity, unequal heights, proportions, roof counts and special balcony must remain correct. Do not draw identical twin pagodas.
LEFT tower: follow the photo's TEN-level total form. Above the broad lower shaft are the successively stepped brick eaves and small shrine openings. Its distinctive TOP stage has sloping pyramidal masonry shoulders with one arched opening below the stacked rounded finial, not an extra conventional storey. Preserve the actual visible sequence rather than arbitrarily adding roof tiers. Indicate a sparse selection of the tiny repetitive shrine niches as empty outlines, not every niche.
RIGHT tower: THIRTEEN architectural levels TOTAL, with lowest THREE enclosed inside the tall fortress-like solid octagonal base drum with crenellated top, as photographed. Above that base exactly TEN exposed storeys rise, crowned by the finial. The projecting open-column glazed balcony belongs to the TENTH level counted from ground (FOURTH exposed level from the TOP). Keep exactly THREE enclosed windowed levels ABOVE this open balcony, then their finial. BELOW the balcony are SIX exposed regular levels above the fortress base. Follow the actual photograph for each tier's different opening arrangement, the one larger tablet recess and the stepped bracketed eaves. Do not add a second balcony. Do not convert fortress base into three free exposed roof storeys.
Show both towers complete, upright, near frontal with slight perspective revealing facets as in the reference. Keep height ratio and left/right spacing as photographed. Remove foreground railings, people, plants, neighbouring buildings, wires and inscriptions; only a few ground lines beneath. Keep the broad observed fortress base shape; no invented elaborate entrance, doorway shrine, staircase or pedestal where the photograph is obscured.
Sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE. No dark-filled windows or shadows, no gray shading, no hatching or grain, no color, dense brickwork or repeated roof texture. All tower walls stay white, use thin clean structural contours and only selected ornament. No lettering, captions, watermark, frame or border. Portrait 1024 x 1536, the full pair occupies about82% width and82% height with generous white margins, no clipping of finials or bases.

historical_sources.title: “江南水乡”——海会寺
historical_sources.evidence: 小塔为五代建、宋代改修，六角十级；大塔明嘉靖四十年1561，八角十三级。

historical_sources.title: 海会寺
historical_sources.publisher: 阳城县人民政府润城镇
historical_sources.evidence: 琉璃悬阁宝塔由李思孝于明嘉靖、隆庆年间捐建，十三层。该文地址写润城沟西村，与旧文北留大桥村不同，地图采用塔院本体坐标而非按乡镇中心定位。

historical_sources.publisher: 维基百科，引用文物与地方史资料
historical_sources.evidence: 大塔下三层包筑八角城垛，第十层出琉璃平座；记录1561及1565—1568两种营建纪年，因此用时代范围不冒认单一年竣工。

site_recommendation.name: 阳城海会寺双塔
site_recommendation.sub: 六角砖塔 · 八角琉璃塔
site_recommendation.era: 明嘉靖—隆庆 · 琉璃大塔
site_recommendation.yearNote: 1565仅为明代大塔营建时段排序点；资料有1561与1565—1568说法。小塔属五代创建、宋代改修，双塔并非同年营建。
site_recommendation.place: 山西阳城 · 大桥村海会寺塔院
site_recommendation.lede: 海会寺的两座砖塔一高一低，像两段历史并肩而立。小塔布满佛龛，大塔在高处伸出琉璃悬阁，城堡状底座又给它格外稳重的轮廓。

facts.label: 小塔十级
facts.text: 六角小砖塔为五代创建、宋代改修，塔身密布小龛，形制与大塔不同。

facts.label: 大塔十三级
facts.text: 明代琉璃大塔为八角十三层，底部三层被城垛式外墙包砌，不能把外露檐数直接当作全部层数。

facts.label: 空中悬阁
facts.text: 第十层向外挑出琉璃平座与围栏，其上仍有三层，构成海会双塔最鲜明的识别点。
